theorems.name: ContextualExample.agrammaticality_example
theorems.source_claim: p.12 agrammatical phrase functions as an example; behavior stipulated in the interpreter.

theorems.name: ContextualExample.graft_preserves_form
theorems.source_claim: Projection property of the added graft operation.

theorems.name: ContextualExample.graft_changes_possible_effect
theorems.source_claim: p.12 context change of the same form; concrete modeled example.

theorems.name: ContextualExample.context_cannot_be_erased_from_this_interpreter
theorems.source_claim: Two modeled contexts disprove context-erasure for THIS interpreter, not every theory.

theorems.name: ContextualExample.absent_producer_can_still_be_read
theorems.source_claim: pp.7–10 absence of producer; an example in a model omitting intention from interpretation.

theorems.name: ContextualExample.producer_metadata_invariant_here
theorems.source_claim: Origin-metadata independence is built into this interpreter, not established for language.

theorems.name: ContextualExample.same_form_need_not_be_same_occurrence
theorems.source_claim: pp.19–20 repeated form need not identify a unique occurrence.

theorems.name: ContextualExample.quotation_depth
theorems.source_claim: Helper lemma about the added quotation syntax.

theorems.name: ContextualExample.fresh_quote_beyond_any_finite_list
theorems.source_claim: Unbounded fresh contexts in the added syntax, not semantic non-saturation.

theorems.name: ContextualExample.quotation_levels_distinct
theorems.source_claim: Distinct depths identify distinct syntactic quotation levels.

theorems.name: ContextualExample.unbounded_quotation_can_keep_effect_constant
theorems.source_claim: Countermodel to inferring semantic variation merely from syntactic unboundedness.

theorems.name: repeatable_form_cannot_recover_both_origins
theorems.source_claim: pp.19–20 motivated information-loss result: equal observed forms and different origins rule out form-only decoding.

theorems.name: richer_evidence_is_not_ruled_out
theorems.source_claim: The conditional form-only result does not exclude richer token evidence; not an authentication algorithm.

theorems.name: signature_form_and_origin_can_diverge
theorems.source_claim: A two-token witness to the premises of the conditional form-only result.

theorems.name: Risk.necessary_risk_coexists_with_success
theorems.source_claim: pp.15–18 successful performances coexist with the possibility of failure in an added modal model.

theorems.name: Risk.necessary_risk_does_not_mean_all_actual_fail
theorems.source_claim: Countermodel to conflating possible failure with all actual performances failing.
